config.expected_if_false: N=128 trained force R2 within 0.02 of the paired N=64 value at the best-margin layer. A gap between 0.02 and 0.04 is reported as inconclusive.
config.expected_if_true: N=128 best-layer trained force R2 at least 0.04 below the paired N=64 seed-24 value. Headroom-normalised accel_step margin in [0.60, 0.88] and accel_step beats its control.
config.hypothesis: This is the test arm of a third-seed width replication. Setup: m2 fixed at 0.5, data_seed 0, e in [0, 0.5], 4 layers, d_model=128, best-of-3 controls, seed 24, 6000 steps, N=128. Prediction: the N=128 force deficit persists at d_model=128, so final trained force R2 stays at least 0.04 below the same seed's d_model=128 N=64 value from the paired arm proposed this cycle, while accel_step decodability is unchanged. Values come from probes_final, unrounded. The headline gap uses best-margin layers, with layers reported and cross-layer pairs flagged. A layer-1 same-layer gap is also reported wherever both arms list layer 1. Within-run values are read only as same-layer control plus margin. Both arms' run IDs are cited. If the paired run is unavailable, the gap is reported as not computed.
